item.title: GTA 6 explained for people who have not been following it
item.description: GTA 6 explained in plain English: what Grand Theft Auto VI is, release date, platforms, editions, rating and what is still unknown as of 14 November 2026.
item.content:encoded:
Grand Theft Auto VI, usually written GTA 6 or GTA VI, is the next main game in Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. If you have not followed the news, this page gives you the basics in plain English, and every claim is labelled by how well it is sourced.

What is GTA 6 in one paragraph?

GTA 6 is a single-player-focused action-adventure game set in the fictional US state of Leonida, with Vice City as its main city. Rockstar describes it with the line "Vice City, USA. The darkest side of the sunniest place in America." You play two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, whose story starts when "an easy score goes wrong" and spirals into criminal conspiracies. It is developed by Rockstar Games and published by Take-Two Interactive. The release date is 19 November 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

  • Release date: 19 November 2026 (confirmed by Rockstar and Take-Two).
  • Platforms: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. No PC version has been announced as of 14 November 2026.
  • Setting: State of Leonida, main city Vice City.
  • Protagonists: Jason and Lucia.

GTA 6 key facts at a glance

Grand Theft Auto VI key facts, status as of 14 November 2026
ItemAnswerStatus
Release date19 November 2026Confirmed
PlatformsPlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|SConfirmed
SettingState of Leonida, Vice CityConfirmed
ProtagonistsJason and LuciaConfirmed
Developer / publisherRockstar Games / Take-Two InteractiveConfirmed
RatingESRB Mature, per Rockstar's official page; PEGI not verifiedESRB confirmed, PEGI unknown
EditionsStandard and Ultimate; Vintage Vice City Pack pre-order bonusNames confirmed
PriceReportedly US$79.99 Standard and US$99.99 UltimateReported
Online modeNone announced; described as a single-player experienceReported
PC versionNot announcedUnknown

Why is everyone talking about GTA 6?

Three things combine. First, the wait: the previous main game, Grand Theft Auto V, came out in 2013, and GTA V has reportedly shipped more than 225 million copies as of the December 2025 quarter. Few entertainment products stay on sale and in the news for that long. Second, the release date moved: according to reports, the game was first aimed at Fall 2025, then 26 May 2026, then 19 November 2026. Rockstar's reported statement said the extra months would allow the team to finish the game "with the level of polish you have come to expect and deserve". Third, the trailers broke records for views, according to reports. Our page on why GTA 6 matters goes into the business and cultural side.

Where and when is it set?

The setting is the state of Leonida, a fictional take on Florida, and its main city is Vice City, a fictional take on Miami. Vice City already appeared in the series: it was the setting of Grand Theft Auto: Vice City in 2002. GTA 6 is a new version of that idea rather than a remake, and Rockstar has not described it as a sequel to the 2002 plot. To see where Vice City fits among earlier games, read how the GTA series got here.

Rockstar's website lists other regions, but this site only names Leonida and Vice City because those are the places we have verified against the official page. The same applies to the map: we do not publish a size comparison, because Rockstar has not given one.

Who are Jason and Lucia?

Rockstar confirms that Jason and Lucia are the two protagonists. Outlets such as GamesRadar report their full names as Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, taken from Rockstar's website update in 2025, and report that Lucia is the first female lead in a main GTA game. The official page frames the story as two people pulled into a crime conspiracy after a job goes wrong. Whether and how you will switch between the two characters has not been confirmed to us, so we do not describe it.

Which platforms can play it?

Only PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S are listed by Rockstar and Take-Two. Rockstar's page reportedly says the game plays best on PlayStation 5, but no PS5 Pro enhancement details have been confirmed. PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions have not been announced, and neither has a PC version. Any claim about a PC date is speculation. The page on what is still unknown keeps a running list of these gaps.

What do you actually get when you buy it?

There are two editions named by Rockstar, Standard and Ultimate, plus a pre-order bonus called the Vintage Vice City Pack. Reported prices are US$79.99 for Standard and US$99.99 for Ultimate; we have not seen them on an official store page, so check the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store or Rockstar Games Store before you pay. Reports also say a boxed copy contains a download code instead of a disc. Everything about the choice between editions, with a comparison table, is on editions explained.

Is it suitable for children?

No, not for young children. The ESRB rating shown on Rockstar's page is Mature, with descriptors for blood and gore, intense violence, mature humor, nudity, strong language, sexual content and use of drugs and alcohol, plus in-game purchases. We have not verified a PEGI rating, so we do not state one. Parents should read the ratings and parental guidance page for the practical steps: console parental controls, spending limits and what the "in-game purchases" label means.

Is there multiplayer?

No GTA VI online mode has been announced as of 14 November 2026. Outlets report that the PlayStation Store FAQ calls the game a single-player experience, which led to commentary about the future of GTA Online, the multiplayer mode of GTA V. There is no official statement about GTA Online ending that we could find. See single-player vs online for a careful reading of what is and is not known.

Which words will you hear?

Fans use shorthand such as "GTA VI", "Leonida", "Vintage Vice City Pack", "preload" and "open world". If a term in a headline confuses you, the GTA glossary explains it in a sentence or two.

How to tell reliable GTA 6 news from rumours

Because the game is so popular, many pages publish guesses as facts. A few quick habits help. Prefer Rockstar's own page and Take-Two's investor filings. Treat a single outlet quoting an unnamed source as unconfirmed. Be suspicious of leaked maps, "system requirements" for consoles, or exact sales figures before the release. Our how we verify facts page lists the labels used on this site: confirmed, reported and unknown. Our team is an independent fan editorial team; see about this site for the disclaimer and privacy details.

Beware scams. Fake "free download" or "early access" offers circulate around every big launch. The only places to buy are the official storefronts and retailers. This site does not link to any download.

GTA 6 timeline in brief

Main GTA 6 milestones
DateEventStatus
December 2023First trailer releasedReported
6 May 2025Second trailer releasedReported
6 November 2025Release moved to 19 November 2026Reported
25 June 2026Pre-orders openedReported
9 November 2026Take-Two reaffirms the date in its earnings releaseConfirmed
12 November 2026Digital preload reportedly startsReported
19 November 2026Release dateConfirmed

On 9 November 2026 Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said pre-orders were continuing to reach "unprecedented levels", but the company has published no unit numbers. For the official reference, visit Rockstar's GTA VI site.

Where should I start?

  1. New to the series? Read the series history.
  2. Deciding what to buy? Use the editions guide.
  3. Buying for a teenager? Read the parental guidance page.
  4. Wondering about gaps in the news? See what is still unknown.

Facts on this page are current as of 14 November 2026. Release date: 19 November 2026.

item.title: Why does GTA 6 matter so much?
item.description: Why Grand Theft Auto VI is treated as an event: the 13-year gap since GTA V, the delays, record trailer views and what Take-Two says about the launch.
item.content:encoded:
If you have wondered why a video game gets front-page coverage, this page explains the reasons in order: the long gap, the money, the delays and the size of the audience. Each number is marked as confirmed or reported.

The 13-year gap

The previous main game, Grand Theft Auto V, arrived in 2013. Most big game series release a new entry every few years. GTA V stayed on sale across three console generations, and GTA VI is its first main successor. That gap is the core reason for the intense attention: an entire generation of players grew up with GTA V as the current game. To see the games in between and what each changed, read how the GTA series got here.

Sales context: the numbers people quote

Take-Two does not publish GTA 6 sales before launch, and we do not either. What can be said is the context.

Sales and business figures, with source status
FigureDetailStatus
GTA V units shipped225 million as of Take-Two's Q3 fiscal 2026 report (December 2025 quarter)Reported
GTA series totalOver 465 million unitsReported
Take-Two FY2027 net bookings guidanceUS$8.0 to 8.2 billion, maintained on 9 November 2026Confirmed (SEC filing)
GTA VI pre-orders"Unprecedented levels"; no numbers givenConfirmed wording

A headline claiming GTA V passed 230 million units exists, but we could not check it against Take-Two's own releases, so we keep the 225 million figure. Be careful with any pre-launch sales prediction: they are estimates, not data.

The delays

According to reports, the game was first planned for Fall 2025, then moved to 26 May 2026, and finally to 19 November 2026, an announcement made on 6 November 2025 alongside Take-Two's earnings. Rockstar's statement, as quoted by outlets, said: "We are sorry for adding additional time to what we realize has been a long wait, but these extra months will allow us to finish the game with the level of polish you have come to expect and deserve." On 9 November 2026 Take-Two reaffirmed the date, so it is not delayed again. The date is also confirmed on Rockstar's official page.

Trailer records

Trailer 1 was published in December 2023. Outlets report it set a Guinness record of roughly 90.4 million YouTube views in 24 hours for a game trailer. Trailer 2, released on 6 May 2025, reportedly drew about 69 million YouTube views in its first day, less than the first, though outlets citing Rockstar figures report roughly 475 million views across all platforms in 24 hours. Treat these numbers as reported; view counts differ by platform and counting method. We have not researched later 2026 trailers, so we do not describe them.

Why it matters beyond Rockstar

  • For the publisher: Take-Two named the launch as the driver of an "historic year" in its 9 November 2026 filing.
  • For other studios: big releases often avoid the same week, which is why release calendars shift around GTA. This is a general industry habit rather than something Rockstar has announced.
  • For console owners: the game is listed only for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, so it is a reason some people consider buying or upgrading a console. Platform details are on the editions page and the home page.
  • For parents and the public: the series is controversial because of its mature content, which is why a separate guide on ratings and parental guidance exists.

What the hype can hide

Big attention produces big noise. Common problems include fake leaks, invented system requirements, and "release time" posts presented as official. For instance, storefronts reportedly show a regional midnight unlock, but Rockstar has not published one global time. We discuss gaps like this on the unknowns page.

Tip: when you see a big number about GTA 6, ask who published it, when and whether it is a forecast or a count. Our verification method uses the same questions.

How Rockstar communicates

Rockstar has a reputation for sharing little: few interviews, a small number of trailers and a website that updates in bursts. When information is scarce, fans fill the space with theories, and some of those theories get repeated as news. Knowing that pattern is the best protection against rumours.

Take-Two, as the publisher, speaks mostly through investor materials. That is why the most reliable business statements about the game come from SEC filings and earnings calls, and why this site cites the 9 November 2026 release directly.

Summary

  1. The gap since GTA V in 2013 is unusually long.
  2. The previous game is among the best-selling ever, reportedly 225 million units shipped.
  3. Delays raised the stakes; the date of 19 November 2026 is confirmed.
  4. Take-Two calls pre-orders unprecedented but gives no figures.

Return to the main GTA 6 explainer for the key-facts table.

item.title: How the GTA series got to GTA 6
item.description: A beginner's history of Grand Theft Auto from the 1997 original to GTA V and GTA VI, with a table of the main games and how Vice City fits in.
item.content:encoded:
You do not need to have played earlier games to enjoy a new Grand Theft Auto, because each main entry tells a separate story. Still, knowing the history explains why GTA VI is such a big deal and why Vice City sounds familiar.

Note on sourcing: the release years below are long-established general history, not items from the GTA VI fact sheet we use for news. GTA VI details elsewhere on this site are checked separately. See how we verify facts.

The main games in order

Main Grand Theft Auto games and what each is known for
GameYearWhat it is known for
Grand Theft Auto1997Top-down view, the original crime sandbox
Grand Theft Auto III2001First fully 3D open world in the series
Grand Theft Auto: Vice City20021980s Miami-style city, strong radio and music identity
Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas2004A whole state with several cities
Grand Theft Auto IV2008More realistic tone, set in Liberty City
Grand Theft Auto V2013Three protagonists, GTA Online, huge sales
Grand Theft Auto VI19 November 2026Leonida, Vice City, Jason and Lucia

There were other releases, including expansions and handheld spin-offs, but the table lists the games most people mean by "the series". Each main game has a self-contained plot, so you can start with GTA VI.

What stays the same in every game

  • An open world: a large city or region you can explore freely, on foot or in vehicles.
  • Story missions plus side activities: a main plot you can follow in order, and optional things to do.
  • Satire of modern life: radio, adverts and television inside the game poke fun at real culture.
  • A mature rating: violence, strong language and adult themes. Details in ratings and parental guidance.

What GTA V changed

GTA V (2013) let players switch between three protagonists and later added GTA Online, a separate multiplayer mode that has been updated for years. Outlets report that GTA V reached 225 million units shipped by the December 2025 quarter, and the franchise more than 465 million. That success is why the follow-up took so long and why expectations are so high. The business side is covered on why GTA 6 matters.

Where Vice City fits

Vice City was the setting of the 2002 game Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. GTA VI uses the name again as the main city of the state of Leonida, and Rockstar's tagline for the new game is "Vice City, USA. The darkest side of the sunniest place in America." This is a new game with new characters, not a remake. Rockstar has not confirmed any story connection to the 2002 plot, so treat "connections" in fan videos as theories.

What is different in GTA VI, as far as we can confirm

Two protagonists

Jason and Lucia are confirmed. GTA V had three, earlier games usually had one.

A return to Vice City

The city is confirmed as the main location inside the state of Leonida.

New hardware

PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only, as of 14 November 2026.

Single-player focus

Reported as a single-player experience, with no online mode announced.

Do I need to play older games first?

No. Rockstar builds each main entry as a separate story. If you want a taste of the series first, GTA V is the most recent, but this is a personal choice rather than a requirement. We do not give advice on where to get older games beyond the official stores.

Terms you will meet while catching up

Words such as "open world", "sandbox", "radio station" and "Online" appear in every discussion. They are explained briefly in the GTA glossary.

How the series is usually described by its critics and fans

Fans praise the scale and detail of the worlds. Critics often point to the controversy around violence and the way each game satirises society. Both views are part of the series story, and each new game revives the debate. We do not give review scores for GTA VI because the game is not yet reviewed in the sources we use.

What to watch for next

After launch, people will want to compare GTA VI with GTA V. Comparisons about map size, number of missions or hours of play need official numbers, and none has been published by Rockstar. When that changes, the unknowns page will be where the answers move from "unknown" to "confirmed". For a general overview, go back to the GTA 6 explainer, or check the official GTA VI site.

A quick way to remember the eras

  • Top-down era (1997): the original game, seen from above.
  • 3D era (2001 to 2004): Grand Theft Auto III, Vice City and San Andreas made the series what most people recognise.
  • HD era (2008 to 2013): Grand Theft Auto IV and V brought modern graphics and online play.
  • Current era (2026): Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

These labels are our own shorthand for readers, not official terms. If you only remember one thing, remember that every main game stands alone, and the long gap before GTA VI is the exception rather than the rule in the series' history.

item.title: GTA 6 editions explained: what you actually get
item.description: What you get with GTA 6 Standard and Ultimate editions, the Vintage Vice City Pack, reported prices, physical vs digital copies and how to avoid scams.
item.content:encoded:
Buying a big game can be confusing. This page explains the GTA 6 editions in plain terms, separates official names from reported details and lists what to check before you pay.

The short answer

Rockstar's official page names two editions of Grand Theft Auto VI, Standard and Ultimate, and a pre-order bonus called the Vintage Vice City Pack. Outlets report prices of US$79.99 for Standard and US$99.99 for Ultimate. We have not seen those prices on an official store page, so use them as a guide only. The game releases on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Standard vs Ultimate

Editions of GTA 6, with confirmation status
QuestionStandardUltimate
Edition name confirmedYesYes
Reported US priceUS$79.99US$99.99
Contents beyond the gameNot verified by usNot verified by us
PlatformsPS5, Xbox Series X|SPS5, Xbox Series X|S

The honest summary is that Rockstar confirms the names, while the contents of each edition and the exact prices should be read from the store you plan to use. We do not list extra items for Ultimate because we could not verify them. Prices in other countries and currencies are not covered by our sources.

The Vintage Vice City Pack

The Vintage Vice City Pack is the confirmed name of the pre-order bonus. According to The National's report, the bonus includes a 1955 Vapid Stanier car, outfits and weapon designs, and was offered for orders placed before 20 November. A report from a single aggregator also mentions one month of GTA+ with a digital pre-order; we treat that as unverified and you should not rely on it. Because the pre-order window may be over by the time you read this, check whether the pack is still offered.

Pre-order and preload

  • Pre-orders: reportedly opened on 25 June 2026 through the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store and retailers.
  • Preload: reportedly starts on 12 November 2026 for digital copies, so you can download before launch.
  • Unlock time: storefronts reportedly show a regional midnight release, but Rockstar has not announced one global time. Check your store listing.

"Preload" means downloading the game files ahead of release. The game stays locked until the unlock time. See the glossary for that and similar terms.

Physical or digital?

The National reports that the boxed copy contains a download code rather than a game disc. That is a report we could not confirm on a store page, so read the product description before you buy a boxed copy. If you want a physical item, check what is inside the box. If you prefer digital, buy directly from the console store so the game is tied to your account.

Is there a PC version, a demo or a PS4 version?

No PC version, demo, beta, PlayStation 4 or Xbox One version has been announced as of 14 November 2026. PS5 Pro details are also missing: Rockstar's page reportedly says the game plays best on PlayStation 5, but we found no official enhancement list. These gaps are tracked on what is still unknown.

Buying checklist

  1. Confirm your console: PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S.
  2. Open the official store listing and read the edition name and price in your currency.
  3. Check what the listing says about the pre-order bonus and the unlock time.
  4. Make sure you have enough free storage before preload; Rockstar has not published a file size we could verify.
  5. Check the age rating and spending settings if the console is shared with a child, as explained in ratings and parental guidance.

Warning: keys sold at suspiciously low prices, "free download" offers and anything asking for your console login are scams or violate store terms. This site does not link to such offers. Use official storefronts.

Does the edition affect online play?

No GTA VI online mode has been announced, so no edition is described as unlocking one. In-game purchases are mentioned in the rating label, but Rockstar has not explained what they are. See single-player vs online.

Verdict: if you only want the game and are unsure, start from Standard and read the official listing for what Ultimate adds. Do not pay extra on the basis of rumours. Official information is at rockstargames.com/VI.

For more general background, return to the GTA 6 explainer.

What to do if the price differs

Store prices vary by country, tax and currency, and may change over time. If the price you see differs from the reported US figures, trust the store. A big discount on a brand-new, unreleased game from an unofficial seller is a warning sign. Retailers also differ in what they include with a pre-order, so read the small print on the product page and keep the order confirmation until you have the game working.

item.title: GTA 6 age rating and guidance for parents
item.description: GTA 6 ESRB Mature rating explained, what the content descriptors mean, PEGI status, parental controls and spending limits for parents on PS5 and Xbox.
item.content:encoded:
If a teenager has asked you for GTA 6, you probably want a straight answer. The game is rated for mature audiences, and this page shows what that means and which console tools can help. It is general guidance, not a review of the game.

The rating, in one table

Age ratings for Grand Theft Auto VI, as of 14 November 2026
SystemRatingStatus
ESRB (US and Canada)MatureDisplayed on Rockstar's official page
PEGI (Europe)Not verifiedWe do not state a PEGI age
Other regionsNot checkedCheck your local board

The ESRB descriptors shown on Rockstar's page are: blood and gore, intense violence, mature humor, nudity, strong language, sexual content and use of drugs and alcohol. The label also includes "in-game purchases". One outlet reports the rating was published on 6 October 2026, but we treat that date as reported only.

What the descriptors mean in practice

Blood and gore, intense violence

Expect graphic violence in missions and in the open world. Younger players should not play.

Strong language and mature humor

Frequent swearing and adult jokes, which are part of the series' satire.

Nudity and sexual content

Adult themes are present. The rating does not tell you how often or how explicit; we have not played the game.

Drugs and alcohol

Characters use drugs and alcohol in the story. This is depicted, not endorsed by the rating.

"Mature" means what age?

ESRB describes Mature as content generally suitable for ages 17 and older. That is the board's general definition, not something specific to this game. PEGI uses different age bands and is not yet verified for GTA 6, so do not rely on social media posts claiming a PEGI number.

What are "in-game purchases"?

The label means the game offers purchases of extra content or currency for real money. Rockstar has not explained what those are in GTA VI, and no online mode is announced, so we cannot say how large they are. Set a spending limit regardless. For the current state of online features, see single-player vs online.

Parental controls: a practical checklist

  1. Create a child account on the console, linked to a family or parent account.
  2. Set an age limit for games in the console's family settings, so a Mature title cannot start under that account.
  3. Restrict purchases: require a password or set a monthly spending cap, or set the child's wallet to zero.
  4. Manage playtime: both PlayStation and Xbox offer play-time schedules in their family tools.
  5. Check chat and social features: if an online mode ever appears, review its communication settings before allowing it.

Menu names differ between PS5 and Xbox Series X|S and change with system updates, so use the console's own help pages for the exact steps.

Tip: talk with your child about why a game is rated Mature. A rating works best alongside a conversation and clear household rules.

Should my child play it?

That is a family decision. Our editorial position is simple: the ESRB Mature rating is the official signal, so GTA 6 is not intended for children. If a teenager is nearly 17, you might want to look at independent reviews after release and, if you can, watch some gameplay yourself. We cannot offer a review of the game because it has not been released at the time of writing.

Gifts and shared consoles

If you buy the game as a gift, the edition does not change the rating. See editions explained for how to buy from official stores. On a shared console, a Mature game can appear in everyone's library; use the age limit setting for children's accounts.

Where to read the official label

The most reliable source is the rating shown on Rockstar's own page at rockstargames.com/VI, and on the store listing of your platform. Ratings can be updated, so look at the date. Our approach to such labels is described in how we verify facts, and open rating questions are in what is still unknown.

For basics about the game, return to the GTA 6 explainer.

Questions to ask before you decide

  • Has my child seen other Mature-rated games, and how did we handle it?
  • Do I know which friends play it, and with whom my child would talk about it?
  • Are console time limits and purchase approvals already set up?
  • Is there a shared family space where the game would be played?

These questions are meant to start a household conversation. They are not a rating system, and no checklist can replace your own judgement about a particular child. Independent reviews written after release will give more detail about the actual content than any label.

item.title: GTA 6 single-player vs online: where things stand
item.description: Is GTA 6 single-player or online? What is reported about the story mode, whether GTA Online continues and why no multiplayer mode is announced yet.
item.content:encoded:
People often ask whether GTA 6 has multiplayer. The accurate answer as of 14 November 2026 is: no online mode has been announced, and outlets report the game is described as a single-player experience.

What is confirmed and what is reported

Single-player and online status of GTA VI
TopicStatus as of 14 November 2026Evidence level
Story with Jason and LuciaConfirmed on Rockstar's pageConfirmed
Described as single-playerReported from the PlayStation Store FAQReported
GTA VI online modeNot announcedUnknown
GTA Online (GTA V) endingNo official statement foundUnknown
Co-op or split-screenNot announcedUnknown

What "single-player" means here

A single-player game is one you play alone, following a story at your own pace. Reports quote the PlayStation Store FAQ calling GTA VI a single-player experience, and outlets such as GamesRadar and PC Gamer wrote that an online mode looks unlikely at launch. We could not read the full original text of those reports, so we describe it as reported. The wording leaves room for later additions, and Rockstar has not said either way.

What is the story mode?

Rockstar's page describes two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, in the state of Leonida, and a story that begins when "an easy score goes wrong" and leads into criminal conspiracies. The page also mentions in-game radio stations and an open world centred on Vice City. We have no confirmed length for the story, number of missions or ending structure. Those are listed on what is still unknown.

What about GTA Online?

GTA Online is the multiplayer mode of the previous game, GTA V. It continues to exist, and we found no official statement that it will close. It is separate from GTA VI: progress, characters and purchases there do not carry into the new game as far as anything announced says. If you play GTA Online now, nothing in the sources we use says you must stop. For the history of that mode, read how the GTA series got here.

Do you need an internet connection?

Rockstar has not published information about online requirements for GTA VI. Console subscriptions such as PlayStation Plus or Xbox online membership are normally needed for online multiplayer, but because no online mode is announced, we cannot say whether any would be needed. We also cannot say whether the game requires an internet connection for the first launch or for updates. Expect a launch-day update, as is common for big releases, but that is a general habit and not a Rockstar statement.

Why does it matter?

  • For buyers: do not pay extra for an edition on the assumption that it includes online access. See editions explained.
  • For parents: an online mode would bring chat and strangers. As of today none is announced, but the rating label mentions in-game purchases; see ratings and parental guidance.
  • For fans: Rockstar could announce future updates or modes at any time, so check official channels instead of rumours.

Typical rumours to ignore

Search results often claim "GTA Online 2 is confirmed", list online features or show a leaked player count. None of that is in Rockstar's materials. Our verification page explains why we ignore single-source or screenshot-only claims. A related detail: reports that you can switch between characters with a button press come from one outlet snippet and are unverified, so we do not state them.

What would change this page?

We will update this page if Rockstar or Take-Two announce an online mode, additional modes, or a closing date for GTA Online. Until then the correct reading is cautious: story-focused, no online mode announced. Compare with the official site: rockstargames.com/VI.

Short version: GTA VI is reported as single-player; no multiplayer is announced; GTA Online for GTA V has not been officially said to end.

More background is in the GTA 6 explainer and the glossary.

How to read future announcements

If Rockstar announces a multiplayer mode later, look for three things: a name, a platform list and a date. Be careful with phrases such as "coming soon" without a source. Also remember that an online mode, if it ever appears, could carry its own rating notice and purchases, so parents would need to revisit their settings. Until then, the safest reading of the available sources is a story-focused game with no announced online component.

Demo or beta?None announcedNo public test announced
GTA Online ending?No statementContinues, no official end date found
Pre-order numbers?Not publishedTake-Two says "unprecedented levels"

Platforms: PC, PS4 and PS5 Pro

The only confirmed platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. People often cite "PC in 2027" or "PC in 2028", but these are speculation and we do not publish them. A PC announcement would come from Rockstar. Likewise, a PS5 Pro mention appears at only one outlet and is not backed by an official enhancement list. See editions explained for how this affects buying.

Content and rating details

The ESRB descriptors are known, but PEGI has not been verified. Read ratings and parental guidance for what to do meanwhile. We also do not know what the "in-game purchases" label refers to.

Gameplay and world details

Rockstar's page confirms two protagonists, radio stations and an open world centred on Vice City. Trailers have shown other things, such as wildlife and social-media parodies, but we did not re-verify them against an official source, so we treat them as trailer content without detailed claims. The names of other regions outside Vice City appear in outlets, but we did not confirm them, so we use only Leonida and Vice City. A map size comparison with GTA V has not been published. The character switching question is explained in single-player vs online.

Release logistics

The release date, 19 November 2026, is confirmed. Less certain are the unlock time in your region and the preload start of 12 November 2026, which is reported by one outlet. Because Rockstar has not announced one global time, check your store page rather than a social media post. If you have a launch-day update in mind, assume nothing about its size.

Business details

Take-Two reaffirmed the date on 9 November 2026 and kept its net bookings guidance at US$8.0 to 8.2 billion. It did not publish pre-order counts or sales forecasts for the game itself. The context is in why GTA 6 matters.

How questions leave this page

  1. Rockstar or Take-Two publishes an answer on an official page or filing.
  2. We check the primary source and note the date.
  3. The item moves to "confirmed" on the relevant page, with the date in the text.

Reports from outlets are labelled reported until a primary source exists; the labels are explained in how we verify facts.

This list reflects our sources as of 14 November 2026. Some answers may already exist on pages we did not read, so check Rockstar's page first.

Questions to treat with caution after launch

After 19 November 2026, new claims will multiply: review scores, sales records, hours played, secrets. Wait for named outlets or Take-Two filings. Early "record sales" posts without a named source are marketing talk, not data. You can use the glossary to decode jargon in such posts, and the home explainer for the baseline facts.

Why unknowns are normal

Many items on this list will only be answered by a store listing, a patch note or a rating board publication. For a game of this size, such details often appear close to release or after it. An empty answer is not a sign of a problem. It means the publisher has not spoken yet, and the correct move is to wait for the primary source rather than accept a guess.

item.title: GTA glossary: terms you will see in GTA 6 news
item.description: A plain-English GTA glossary: Leonida, Vice City, open world, GTA Online, preload, ESRB, take-two, wanted level and other terms used in GTA 6 news.
item.content:encoded:
News about Grand Theft Auto VI uses a lot of jargon from gaming and business. Each term below gets a short definition. Where a term refers to a GTA 6 fact, we say whether it is confirmed.

The game and the series

Terms about the game
TermMeaning
GTA 6 / GTA VIShort forms of Grand Theft Auto VI, the next main game, released 19 November 2026.
Rockstar GamesThe studio that develops the games. Rockstar is a label of Take-Two.
Take-Two InteractiveThe publisher and parent company, which reports earnings to investors.
LeonidaThe fictional US state where GTA VI is set. Confirmed.
Vice CityThe main city of the game; the name also belongs to the 2002 game Grand Theft Auto: Vice City.
Jason and LuciaThe two confirmed protagonists. Reported full names: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
ProtagonistA main character the player controls.
MainlineA numbered main game, as opposed to a spin-off.
Spin-offA side game that is not a numbered entry.
Open worldA game map you can freely explore instead of following fixed levels.
SandboxA game that gives you freedom to choose what to do.
MissionA story task with a goal, as opposed to free exploration.
Side activityOptional content not required to finish the story.
Radio stationIn-game radio with music, talk and adverts. Confirmed as a feature.
Wanted levelA series mechanic where police respond to crimes. Not detailed for GTA VI.
NPCA non-player character, controlled by the game.

The series history shows where each of these ideas started.

Buying and release

Terms about buying and release
TermMeaning
Standard editionThe base version of the game. Confirmed as a name.
Ultimate editionThe higher-priced version. Confirmed as a name; contents not verified by us.
Vintage Vice City PackThe pre-order bonus name.
Pre-orderBuying before release to secure a copy or bonus.
PreloadDownloading files before release; the game stays locked until the unlock time.
Unlock timeThe moment the game becomes playable. Not announced globally.
Day-one patchAn update released on launch day that fixes problems.
DelayA move to a later release date. GTA VI had delays, per reports.
Gone goldIndustry phrase meaning the game is finished for manufacture.
Digital codeA key to redeem a game on a console store. Reportedly in boxed copies.
StorefrontAn online shop, such as the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store.
GTA+Rockstar's subscription service. Its link to GTA VI is unverified.

The purchase side is covered by editions explained.

Ratings and safety

Terms about ratings and safety
TermMeaning
ESRBEntertainment Software Rating Board, the rating body for the US and Canada. GTA VI shows Mature.
PEGIPan European Game Information, the European age rating system. Not verified for GTA VI.
Content descriptorA label that says why a game got its rating.
In-game purchasesOptional paid extras inside a game.
Parental controlsConsole settings that restrict games, spending and time.
Family accountA linked account structure used to manage children's profiles.

See ratings and parental guidance for the steps.

Online and platforms

Terms about modes and hardware
TermMeaning
Single-playerA game you play alone. GTA VI is reported as one.
MultiplayerPlay with others online or locally. None announced for GTA VI.
GTA OnlineThe online mode of GTA V.
Co-opPlayers team up rather than compete.
PS5, Xbox Series X|SThe two confirmed platforms.
PS5 ProA stronger PS5 model. No GTA VI enhancements confirmed.
Last-genOlder consoles, PS4 and Xbox One. Not announced.
PortA version adapted for another platform, such as PC.

More on the online question: single-player vs online.

Verification terms used on this site

  • Confirmed: stated on an official Rockstar page or a Take-Two filing.
  • Reported: published by a news outlet, not checked against an official page.
  • Unknown: not announced; shown on what is still unknown.
  • Speculation: a guess, which we do not publish as fact.

The method is in how we verify facts. Official reference: rockstargames.com/VI.

Short phrases you may meet in comments

  • "Hype train": fast-growing excitement around a release.
  • "Leak": information that escaped before an official announcement. We do not publish leaks.
  • "Datamine": digging through game files for hidden information, usually unreliable.
  • "Copium": slang for wishful thinking, common in comment sections.
  • "Launch window": the planned period for a release.

Slang changes quickly, and these entries describe general internet use, not Rockstar terms.

item.title: How we verify GTA 6 facts
item.description: How this fan site checks GTA 6 facts: confirmed, reported and unknown labels, which sources we trust first, how we handle leaks and how to report errors.
item.content:encoded:
GTA 6 attracts rumours, fake leaks and recycled headlines. We use a simple, repeatable method to keep facts apart from guesses. You can apply the same method to any page about the game, including ours.

Our three labels

Evidence labels used on this site
LabelMeaningExample
ConfirmedStated on an official Rockstar page or in a Take-Two filing that we read directlyRelease date of 19 November 2026
ReportedPublished by a news outlet; not checked against an official page; written with attributionUS$79.99 and US$99.99 price points
UnknownNot announced, or only seen in snippets; we do not state it as factPC version, PEGI rating

Source order

  1. Rockstar's official page, rockstargames.com/VI, for the game's name, date, platforms, editions, setting and rating label.
  2. Take-Two filings and earnings releases on the SEC site for business statements, such as the 9 November 2026 reaffirmation of the date.
  3. Established news outlets for details that the first two do not cover, always with attribution.
  4. Everything else is treated as unverified and kept out of the text.

What we do not publish

  • Leaks, stolen footage or datamined content.
  • Map sizes, system requirements, review scores or sales numbers that nobody official has released.
  • PC dates, PS5 Pro details or PEGI numbers without a primary source.
  • Piracy, cracks, "free download" links, cheats for online play or gambling content.

The list of open items is kept on what is still unknown.

A worked example

Take the price. Several outlets report US$79.99 for Standard and US$99.99 for Ultimate. We have not seen the figures on an official store page. So we write "reportedly" and tell readers to check the store, as on editions explained. Compare the release date: it is on Rockstar's page and in Take-Two's 8-K, so we write it as a plain fact.

Another example is the unlock time. A site claims a specific global hour. Rockstar has not published one, and storefronts reportedly show regional midnight. We say exactly that and no more.

Why summaries need care

Some pages we use are long or only partly available to us, and automated summaries can garble details. When our notes flag a risk, such as the middle step of the delay history, we attribute the claim and avoid stating more than the sources support. This is why the delay history in why GTA 6 matters says "according to reports".

Dates and updates

Every page is written as of 14 November 2026. We try to phrase things so they remain accurate after launch, for example "release date: 19 November 2026" rather than "coming in five days". When a fact changes, the page changes, and the glossary and unknowns pages are updated first because they gather the most-searched questions.

General background is labelled too

Series history, such as the years of earlier games on the history page, is long-established public knowledge and is not part of the GTA VI fact sheet. We say this on the page itself.

How to check a GTA 6 claim yourself

  1. Who said it, and is it Rockstar or Take-Two?
  2. Is there a date and a link to the primary page?
  3. Is it a fact, a forecast or an opinion?
  4. Do two independent outlets cite the same primary source, or just each other?
  5. Does it include a specific number nobody has released, such as a map size?

If you find an error on this site, tell the site owner. We correct mistakes and note meaningful changes.

For parents, the same method applies to age ratings; see ratings and parental guidance. Details about who we are: about this site. Terms are defined in the glossary.

Limits of our method

No method is perfect. We read official pages and filings, but some pages are long, and some details may change after we read them. We also cannot check store prices in every country. That is why many entries tell you to confirm on the store, and why reported items are always attributed. Where we are unsure, we say so and show the item on the unknowns list. We would rather publish a short, honest answer than a long, impressive guess.

Our editorial team is independent, and no company has paid for or reviewed our pages. The site carries no adverts for downloads or key sellers.

This site is run by an independent fan editorial team. It is unofficial and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and related names are trademarks of their owners.

What we do

We explain GTA 6 for people who have not followed it: what it is, the history, editions, ratings, online status and open questions. Start with the main explainer or read how we verify facts.

Sources policy

Official Rockstar and Take-Two sources come first. Reports from outlets are attributed, and unverified claims are left out. Facts are current as of 14 November 2026. See what is still unknown. Official site: rockstargames.com/VI.

Privacy

  • The hosting server keeps ordinary server logs.
  • We use Ahrefs Web Analytics, which gives aggregate statistics without cookies.
  • We set no cookies of our own and have no accounts or comment forms.
  • We do not sell or collect personal data.

Contact

Contact is via the site owner. We do not publish an email address on the site. For corrections, mention the page and the claim.

Please note

We do not offer downloads, cracks, cheats for online play or gambling content, and we do not link to any. For game information on buying, see editions explained; for families, ratings and parental guidance.
